method.frameTiming: Medians of 12 measured render/gl.finish frames after 6 warmup frames per baseline/variant/control; fixed scene and camera.
method.stableCriterion: Baseline/control drift <=15%. A stable pair may still contain variant outliers.
method.caveat: Group removal is a full-cost upper bound, savings overlap and must not be added. Live FPS across runs is not a causal before/after comparison.
